What becomes visible in NeuroGuide Journey is that naming internal states reduces cognitive uncertainty load.

→ unstructured emotion increases internal prediction effort
→ labeling reduces ambiguity in emotional processing
→ and clarity improves navigation of internal experience

So it’s not just defining feelings.

It’s reducing system noise through structured internal mapping.
